manifest.working_space_method: Sampled socket routes are exact unions of all their poses, subtracted from material pose by pose; no swept 3D union and no cropping.

battery.reference_note: Uses the larger of retailer nominal width and PKCell drawing maxima; drawing maxima are 20.5 x 27.5 x 4.3 mm, not measured wrapping.

cap_clearance_screen.reference_orientation: 17.5 mm along X, the switch stem-post axis; 16.6 mm along Y
orientation_evidence: Sourced Kailh Choc V1 switch mesh: two stem posts at X +/-2.25..3.45 mm (5.7 mm apart along X).
Adafruit 5737 official underside photo: both stem sockets lie along the visually wider cap axis; segmented width/height ratio 1.054-1.057, matching 17.5/16.6 = 1.054.
cap_clearance_screen.dimension_source: Adafruit 5111 same-family page lists 17.5 x 16.6 mm; the 5737 page lists no dimensions. Inferred, not measured.
